proves.claim: lastReleaseTag picks the highest vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tag, comparing each part as a number.

moves.last-release.highest-by-number.why: The last released kernel must be found the same way on every machine; text order puts v0.9.10 before v0.9.9.
